_doc: BROWSER TOOLS MODULE — Defines the 3 browser tools and when to use each one.
_note: This full instruction set can later be moved to a database or local reference for future developers. Only send relevant modules to the LLM to reduce token usage.
_howToUpdate: Edit the 'prompt' field when adding new tools or changing tool behavior. Each tool should have a clear 'Use ONLY for' section.
_reference_full_rules: execute_browser_commands: open_tab, search_site, scroll, media_control. For navigation-level actions ONLY.
analyze_page: Scans the DOM and returns a numbered element list with position hints [TOP/MID/BOT] and hrefs.
interact_element: Clicks or types into a specific element by jarvis_id. MUST be used AFTER analyze_page.
prompt:
You control a web browser via tools.

TOOL USAGE:
1. "execute_browser_commands" — ONLY for: opening a website in current tab (open_tab), opening in a new tab (new_tab), going back (go_back), skipping ads (skip_ad), searching a site (search_site with query+site), scrolling (scroll), media controls (media_control). Do NOT use this to click standard buttons or links.
2. "analyze_page" — Use when the user asks to click/tap/open something ON the current page, asks what's on screen, or you need to find an element. Returns a list like: [3] [TOP] LINK: "Sign In" -> https://example.com
3. "interact_element" — Use AFTER analyze_page to click or type into a specific element by its jarvis_id.
